title: 😮 Priya finds a circle in the kitchen... is the egg one too? #kids #shapes #preschool
title_alts: 😮 Priya traces a bottle cap... the shape with no corners at all #kids #shapes
😮 Priya nearly calls the egg a circle... how to spot the oval #kids #shapes
refrain: Round and round, no corners found
description_hook: One shape hides all over the kitchen. We find the circle on a plate, a bottle cap and a bicycle wheel, then sort it out from an egg.

characters.name: Priya
characters.description: five years old, short black bob with a red clip, yellow t-shirt and denim shorts, one blue sock always slipping down

scenes.narration: Today we learn one shape. It is the circle, round all over.
scenes.caption: आज हम केवल एक आकार सीखेंगे। यह है वृत्त, हर तरफ़ से गोल।
scenes.image_brief: A round white plate resting on a light wooden kitchen table next to a folded blue cloth napkin, soft morning sunlight falling across the table from a window.

scenes.narration: Circle. Say it again: circle. No corners, no straight edges, just one smooth curve.
scenes.caption: वृत्त। फिर बोलो: वृत्त। कोई कोना नहीं, कोई सीधी धार नहीं, बस गोल रेखा।
scenes.image_brief: One smooth dark circle drawn in a single unbroken line on a sheet of white paper lying on a wooden table, nothing else on the paper, gentle daylight.

scenes.narration: Look at the bottle cap on the table. Its flat top is a circle.
scenes.caption: मेज़ पर रखे बोतल के ढक्कन को देखो। उसका चपटा ऊपरी हिस्सा वृत्त है।
scenes.image_brief: A single blue metal bottle cap lying flat on a pale wooden table with its round top facing upward, bright even daylight and a soft shadow beside it.

scenes.narration: Your turn now. Trace the round edge and say circle with me.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। गोल किनारे पर घुमाओ और मेरे साथ बोलो: वृत्त।
scenes.image_brief: A blue bottle cap on a sheet of white paper on a wooden table, with a red crayon line drawn all the way around its edge, warm lamplight from above.

scenes.narration: Round and round, no corners found. Round and round, no corners found.
scenes.caption: गोल गोल घूमो, कोना कहीं न मिले। गोल गोल घूमो, कोना कहीं न मिले।
scenes.image_brief: Three round things in a neat row on a wooden table: a blue bottle cap, a white plate and a round biscuit, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Circles hide outdoors too. A bicycle wheel is a circle. So is the moon.
scenes.caption: वृत्त बाहर भी छिपे हैं। साइकिल का पहिया वृत्त है। चाँद भी।
scenes.image_brief: A bicycle leaning against a garden wall with its round front wheel clearly visible, and a full pale moon in the sky above, soft blue dusk light.

scenes.narration: Which is a circle, the plate or the egg? The plate. An egg is an oval.
scenes.caption: वृत्त कौन है — थाली या अंडा? थाली। अंडा अंडाकार होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A white round plate and one brown egg side by side on a wooden kitchen table, the plate perfectly round and the egg clearly longer than it is wide, clear daylight.

scenes.narration: We found circles: a cap, a wheel, the moon. Round and round, no corners found.
scenes.caption: आज के वृत्त: ढक्कन, पहिया, चाँद। गोल गोल घूमो, कोना कहीं न मिले।
scenes.image_brief: A blue bottle cap, a bicycle wheel and a round paper moon cut-out arranged together on a wooden table, warm evening lamplight.

title: 🤔 Dev cuts his sandwich into a triangle... how many sides make one? #kids #shapes
title_alts: 🤔 Dev counts the corners of a party hat... three sides, one triangle #kids #shapes
🤔 Dev nearly counts four sides on a triangle... what to check first #kids #shapes
refrain: Three sides, three corners, a triangle
description_hook: A sandwich, a tent and a sail all share one shape. We count the three sides of a triangle together, then tell it apart from a door.

characters.name: Dev
characters.description: four years old, curly brown hair, green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, carries a small cloth lunch bag

scenes.narration: Today we learn the triangle. One shape, three straight sides.
scenes.caption: आज हम त्रिभुज सीखेंगे। एक आकार, तीन सीधी भुजाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A triangle cut from bright orange paper lying alone in the middle of a white plate on a wooden lunch table, soft midday light from a window.

scenes.narration: Triangle. Say it slowly: tri-an-gle. Three sides, three corners, every time.
scenes.caption: त्रिभुज। धीरे बोलो: त्रि-भु-ज। तीन भुजाएँ, तीन कोने, हर बार।
scenes.image_brief: A single triangle drawn in thick dark lines on white paper on a wooden table, each of its three corners marked with a small dot, gentle daylight.

scenes.narration: Cut a sandwich corner to corner. Each half is a triangle.
scenes.caption: सैंडविच को कोने से कोने तक काटो। हर आधा हिस्सा त्रिभुज है।
scenes.image_brief: A square sandwich on a white plate cut once from corner to corner, the two triangle halves pulled slightly apart, on a wooden lunch table in warm daylight.

scenes.narration: Say it with me. Triangle. Tap the three corners as you count.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ बोलो। त्रिभुज। गिनते हुए तीनों कोनों को छुओ।
scenes.image_brief: One triangle half of a sandwich on a white plate with three small wooden counting beads placed at its three corners, bright kitchen daylight.

scenes.narration: Three sides, three corners, a triangle. Three sides, three corners, a triangle.
scenes.caption: तीन भुजाएँ, तीन कोने, यह त्रिभुज। तीन भुजाएँ, तीन कोने, यह त्रिभुज।
scenes.image_brief: Three orange paper triangles of different sizes laid in a row on a wooden table, each one clearly three sided, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Triangles live outside too. A tent's sloping side is a triangle.
scenes.caption: त्रिभुज बाहर भी मिलते हैं। तंबू की ढलान त्रिभुज है।
scenes.image_brief: A small blue camping tent pitched on green grass in a garden, its front opening forming a clear triangle, bright late afternoon sunlight.

scenes.narration: A sail on a little boat makes a triangle too.
scenes.caption: छोटी नाव का पाल भी त्रिभुज बनाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small white sailboat on calm blue water near a shore, its single white sail stretched into a clear triangle, soft golden evening light.

scenes.narration: Which has three sides, a door or a party hat? The party hat. A door has four.
scenes.caption: तीन भुजाएँ किसमें हैं — दरवाज़े में या पार्टी टोपी में? टोपी में। दरवाज़े में चार।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden door with four straight edges and a striped paper party hat standing beside it on the floor, the hat clearly three sided, calm indoor daylight.

scenes.narration: Triangles today: a sandwich half, a tent, a sail. Three sides, three corners, a triangle.
scenes.caption: आज के त्रिभुज: सैंडविच का आधा, तंबू, पाल। तीन भुजाएँ, तीन कोने, यह त्रिभुज।
scenes.image_brief: A triangle sandwich half, a small blue tent and a white sailboat shown together on a wooden table as paper cut-outs, warm evening lamplight.

title: ✨ Tara counts the points on a star... is five right or six? #kids #shapes #preschool
title_alts: ✨ Tara presses a gold star sticker... the shape with five sharp points #kids #shapes
✨ Tara slices okra and a star appears... why six points is wrong #kids #shapes
description_hook: A sticker, a starfish and a sliced okra pod all hide the same shape. We count the five points of a star, then check it against a triangle.

characters.name: Tara
characters.description: five years old, two black plaits tied with green ribbons, purple dungarees, a gold star sticker on the back of her hand

scenes.narration: Today's shape is the star. Five sharp points.
scenes.caption: आज का आकार है तारा। पाँच नुकीली नोकें।
scenes.image_brief: One bright yellow paper star with five points lying in the middle of a dark blue cloth on a wooden table, soft warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: Star. Say it twice: star, star. Count the points: one, two, three, four, five.
scenes.caption: तारा। दो बार बोलो: तारा, तारा। नोकें गिनो: एक, दो, तीन, चार, पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: A five pointed star drawn in thick dark lines on white paper on a wooden table, each point tipped with a small dot, gentle daylight.

scenes.narration: A gold sticker on your drawing is a star.
scenes.caption: तुम्हारी ड्रॉइंग पर लगा सुनहरा स्टिकर एक तारा है।
scenes.image_brief: A crayon drawing of a small house on white paper with one shiny gold star sticker pressed onto the top corner, warm desk lamplight.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Say star, and hold up five fingers.
scenes.caption: तुम्हारी बारी। तारा बोलो और पाँच उँगलियाँ ऊपर उठाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Five gold star stickers pressed in a row along the edge of a sheet of white paper on a wooden table, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Five points, one shining star. Five points, one shining star.
scenes.caption: पाँच नोकें, एक चमकता तारा। पाँच नोकें, एक चमकता तारा।
scenes.image_brief: Three yellow paper stars of different sizes laid out on a dark blue cloth, each one with five clear points, warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: Stars turn up elsewhere. A starfish has five arms.
scenes.caption: तारे और जगहों पर भी मिलते हैं। स्टारफ़िश की पाँच बाँहें होती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An orange starfish resting on wet grey sand at the edge of shallow water, its five arms spread wide, bright afternoon sunlight.

scenes.narration: Slice an okra across. The seeds sit inside a tiny star.
scenes.caption: भिंडी को आड़ा काटो। बीज अंदर एक नन्हा तारा बनाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A green okra pod sliced across on a wooden cutting board, the cut face showing a small star of pale seeds inside, clear kitchen daylight.

scenes.narration: Look up after dark. The sky fills with stars.
scenes.caption: अँधेरा होने पर ऊपर देखो। आसमान तारों से भर जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A dark night sky full of small bright stars above the quiet rooftops of a village, calm moonlight.

scenes.narration: Does a star have five points or three? Five. Three makes a triangle.
scenes.caption: तारे में पाँच नोकें होती हैं या तीन? पाँच। तीन से त्रिभुज बनता है।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow five pointed star and an orange triangle lying side by side on a dark blue cloth on a wooden table, soft lamplight.

scenes.narration: Three stars found: a sticker, a starfish, okra seeds. Five points, one shining star.
scenes.caption: तीन तारे मिले: स्टिकर, स्टारफ़िश, भिंडी के बीज। पाँच नोकें, एक चमकता तारा।
scenes.image_brief: A gold star sticker, an orange starfish and a sliced okra pod placed together on a wooden table, warm evening lamplight.

title: 💖 Ishan picks the red crayon... which fruit is red and which is not? #kids #colours
title_alts: 💖 Ishan hunts red at snack time... the colour of a ripe tomato #kids #colours
💖 Ishan almost calls the banana red... the fruit to grab instead #kids #colours
description_hook: Red is the loudest colour in the crayon box. We match it to a tomato, a fire engine and a ladybird, then test it on two fruits.

characters.name: Ishan
characters.description: four years old, straight black hair cut short, red-striped t-shirt and blue shorts, a paper crown he refuses to take off

scenes.narration: Today's colour is red. Bright, warm red.
scenes.caption: आज का रंग है लाल। चमकीला, गरम लाल।
scenes.image_brief: A single bright red crayon lying alone on a sheet of white paper on a wooden table, its paper wrapper red as well, clear window light.

scenes.narration: Red. Whisper it, then say it louder: red. The colour of a ripe tomato.
scenes.caption: लाल। धीरे बोलो, फिर ज़ोर से: लाल। पके टमाटर का रंग।
scenes.image_brief: One ripe red tomato sitting on a white plate on a wooden kitchen table, its skin smooth and deep red, soft daylight from one side.

scenes.narration: Find the red crayon in the box. Press it down and colour.
scenes.caption: डिब्बे में से लाल क्रेयॉन निकालो। दबाकर रंग भरो।
scenes.image_brief: An open cardboard crayon box on a wooden table with the red crayon lifted out and resting beside a half coloured red patch on white paper, warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: Now you say it. Red. Point at something red nearby.
scenes.caption: अब तुम बोलो। लाल। पास रखी कोई लाल चीज़ दिखाओ।
scenes.image_brief: A red rubber ball, a red apple and a red woollen mitten grouped on a pale wooden playroom floor, soft afternoon daylight.

scenes.narration: Red like a ripe tomato. Red like a ripe tomato.
scenes.caption: लाल जैसे पका टमाटर। लाल जैसे पका टमाटर।
scenes.image_brief: A red crayon and a ripe tomato side by side on white paper on a wooden table, the two reds almost matching, gentle daylight.

scenes.narration: Red waits outside too. A fire engine is red, and so is a ladybird.
scenes.caption: लाल बाहर भी है। दमकल की गाड़ी लाल होती है, और लेडीबर्ड भी।
scenes.image_brief: A red fire engine parked on a quiet village street with a small red ladybird resting on a green leaf nearby, bright sunny light.

scenes.narration: Quick question. Is a banana red? No, it is yellow. A strawberry is red.
scenes.caption: छोटा सवाल। क्या केला लाल है? नहीं, वह पीला है। स्ट्रॉबेरी लाल है।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow banana and a red strawberry lying side by side on a white plate on a wooden kitchen table, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Look what was red: a crayon, a tomato, a fire engine. Red like a ripe tomato.
scenes.caption: आज लाल क्या था: क्रेयॉन, टमाटर, दमकल की गाड़ी। लाल जैसे पका टमाटर।
scenes.image_brief: A red crayon, a ripe tomato and a small red toy fire engine arranged in a row on a wooden table, warm evening lamplight.
